    """
    Rerun a set or subset of Monte Carlo simulations using the Basilisk library.

        scenario_name (str): Name of the scenario to run.
        num_processes (int): Number of processes to spawn.

        retention_policies (list or None): List of RetentionPolicy objects to add.
        ic_dir (str): Directory for initial conditions.
        archive_dir (str): Directory for archiving results.

        disperse_seeds (bool): Whether to disperse seeds.
